release_authority.owner: V3 Actor Developmental Causality Engine / External Admission Court
release_authority.jurisdiction: Decide whether one externally proposed observable interaction/event becomes exactly one V3 external-runtime causal event. Admission creates occurrence identity only; causal effects are governed separately by V3 event semantics.

historical_archive.authority_limit: Recovered V3/V2/server material is continuity and authority-recovery evidence only; historical V5/DDM has zero authority over current V550+.

Recovered run_llm_band can force the first candidate when scoring selects nothing and then apply event/magnet deltas directly to state.
Recovered server/V2 session machinery persists transcript, chat-turn counters, prompt/model/output artifacts, and render/session state but has no V3 admission sovereignty.
Recovered V2 renderer/session continuity is compatible only as proposal/audit continuity; transcript existence and rendered output are not causal occurrence.

direct_semantic_consumers: V3-P11 optional LLM proposal path if enabled
V2-P9 causal interaction wiring as a receipt/publication-gate consumer

separate_adjacent_authorities.CAN-024: V2/application interaction-mode policy; does not decide admission.
separate_adjacent_authorities.CAN-025: V2→V3 external-event packaging contract; must map into this V3 ingress contract but does not decide admission.
separate_adjacent_authorities.CAN-013: Optional V3 LLM proposal adapter; proposal only, never admission or mutation.
separate_adjacent_authorities.MUST-020: V3 causal randomness policy; randomness may select among lawful candidates but cannot supply admission authority.

proposal_envelope.hash_law: proposal_hash = SHA-256(RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme bytes of the admission-relevant V3_EXTERNAL_ADMISSION_ENVELOPE projection with proposal_hash and transport-only metadata omitted). The projection schema/version is replay provenance.

required_fields.proposal_id: Immutable proposal identity; never reused for different content.
observable: immutable payload bytes or immutable payload_ref+hash

proposal_envelope.v2_schema_boundary: This is V3's required ingress contract only. CAN-025 owns the physical V2 packaging schema and may use different transport names if it losslessly maps to these V3-required fields.

epistemic_classes.nonpromotion_law: Admission preserves the proposal's epistemic class. A user/caller assertion is admissible, if otherwise lawful, as the fact that the assertion/interaction occurred; its propositional content does not become objective generated truth.

ordered_checks: IDENTITY_LOOKUP: same proposal_id with different proposal_hash -> INVALID; same terminal proposal_id/hash -> idempotent stored receipt.
SCHEMA_AND_INTEGRITY: supported schema/version, all required fields, canonical hash match, immutable payload/hash, no contradictory duplicate keys.
FORBIDDEN_AUTHORITY_FIELDS: proposal contains no proposer-owned admission/effect/state-mutation/cursor-after directive.
PRODUCER_PROVENANCE: producer class/ref/version and source hashes are governed and sufficient; explicit producer denial rejects.
SUBJECT_BINDING: subject_actor_id exists and causal-parent binding belongs to that actor.
EVENT_KIND_BINDING: event_family/kind/direction are governed and externally admissible; no fallback remapping to a generic event kind.
CAUSAL_PARENT_CONCURRENCY: expected V3 event cursor/history hash matches the lawful admission point or an explicitly governed admission window.
SESSION_BINDING_IF_PRESENT: causal_session_id and expected causal-session cursor match V3 state; V2/session counters are not substitutes.
PARTICIPANT_AND_TEMPORAL_BINDING: required participants and lawful V3 temporal placement are resolvable without caller-created actor facts.

OUTBOUND_ARTIFACT_BINDING_IF_PRESENT: exact candidate artifact/hash and render receipt/hash verify; status is pending; actor/context/predecessor bindings match; artifact has no prior terminal rejection or different admission.
REQUIRED_EVENT_SEMANTICS: any authority required merely to represent this event kind coherently is available; missing required semantics defers rather than invents.
EXPLICIT_DENIALS: any governed negative/denial condition rejects; no positive check overrides an explicit denial.
ADMIT only if every required check is positive and no unresolved required authority remains.
precedence: same terminal proposal id+hash => return stored terminal receipt without re-mutation
missing/unknown required authority or binding => DEFER

ADMIT.meaning: The exact proposed observable occurrence becomes exactly one immutable V3 external-runtime causal event.
mutations_allowed: append exactly one admitted event to DevelopmentalEventLedger
advance V3 event-ledger cursor exactly once
for an outbound session-bound actor event, advance V3-owned causal-session cursor exactly once

REJECT.meaning: Well-formed proposal was evaluated with sufficient authority and is not admissible.

DEFER.meaning: Well-formed proposal cannot yet receive a lawful decision because required governed authority/binding/data is missing or unresolved.
DEFER.retry_law: Same immutable proposal may be reevaluated only after named blockers change; each attempt has a new immutable receipt linked to prior DEFER receipts.

INVALID.meaning: Proposal cannot lawfully enter the admission court because envelope/integrity/identity binding is malformed, contradictory, or content-colliding.

event_identity.cardinality: one proposal -> zero or one admitted event; one admitted event -> exactly one proposal_id

proposal_to_event.ADMIT: admitted_event_id is non-null and permanently bound to proposal_id+proposal_hash.

event_identity.outbound_artifact_uniqueness: One candidate_artifact_id+hash may bind to at most one admitted outbound event. An artifact terminally rejected for causal publication remains audit-only; it may not be re-proposed under a new proposal_id to evade rejection.

idempotence.same_proposal_id_same_hash_after_ADMIT: Return same stored admission receipt/event; no new event and no cursor advancement.
idempotence.same_proposal_id_same_hash_after_REJECT_: Return same stored terminal receipt; no reevaluation or mutation.
idempotence.same_proposal_id_same_hash_after_DEFER: May reevaluate only as a new evaluation_attempt when named defer blockers may have changed.
idempotence.rerender: A rerender is a new artifact identity/hash and requires a new proposal and independent admission. No admission inheritance.

effect_boundary.effect_semantics: Only separately governed V3 causal event rules may derive/apply effects from an admitted_event_id. Proposal-authored effects, V2 appraisal/move semantics, transcript state, or LLM deltas have zero causal authority.
effect_boundary.missing_effect_authority: If a separate rule is required merely to represent the proposed event kind coherently and is unavailable, DEFER. Otherwise the occurrence may be admitted and downstream optional consequences remain absent until governed; no default effect is invented.

artifact_publication_law.law: In IN_WORLD_CAUSAL use, rendering is not occurrence. The exact candidate artifact/hash remains noncausal until this rule ADMITs the outbound observable actor event. Only the corresponding ADMIT receipt authorizes the application to publish/commit that exact artifact as something that occurred in generated life.
on_admit: application may commit the admitted artifact as in-world causal transcript event
application may expose the utterance/action as actually occurred
application may mirror the receipt-authorized causal-session cursor advance
on_reject: candidate never enters generated causal transcript/history
candidate cannot affect later V3 state
application fails closed or obtains/renders a different governed candidate under later policy
artifact_publication_law.post_render_change: Any rerender or substantive post-render transform producing a new artifact identity/hash is a new candidate and needs new admission. Admission never transfers by visible-text equality or semantic similarity.

v3_event_ledger_cursor.advance: Every ADMIT appends one event and advances exactly once; REJECT/DEFER/INVALID do not advance.

causal_session_cursor.owner: V3 admission state; application may only mirror a receipt-authorized value
causal_session_cursor.scope: Session-bound causal exchanges only; environment/non-session events may have null causal_session_id/cursor.
causal_session_cursor.inbound_admit: Does not advance the application-visible causal-session turn cursor; it advances only the V3 event-ledger cursor and becomes the governed predecessor for the candidate render.
causal_session_cursor.outbound_admit: Advances causal_session_cursor from N to N+1 atomically with exact outbound event admission.
causal_session_cursor.idempotent_retry: Returns original before/after values; never increments twice.
causal_session_cursor.separation: V2 session_cursor/chat_turn_counter/transcript position is not the V3 causal_session_cursor.

receipt_schema.receipt_identity: v3admrcpt:<sha256(RFC8785_JCS(receipt body with receipt_id and receipt_hash omitted))>; receipt bytes are immutable.
receipt_schema.atomicity: An ADMIT receipt is valid only if event append, event-id/hash binding, event-ledger cursor update, and any outbound causal-session cursor update commit atomically. Partial success fails closed and yields no ADMIT publication authority.
receipt_schema.audit_time_law: Wall-clock evaluation timestamp may be recorded as noncausal audit metadata but is never replay input or generated event time.

must_record: proposal ID/hash and immutable payload/source hashes
decision reason codes and evaluation attempt
causal-session ID and before/after cursor where applicable
replay_provenance.replay_law: Replay never refetches mutable external truth to reinterpret a historical decision. It reuses captured immutable proposal/payload/provenance hashes and the exact historical admission-rule version. Hidden wall clock, mutable latest, filesystem order, LLM output not captured by hash, or a current network lookup cannot alter the replayed decision.

failure_and_reason_codes.fail_closed_law: Any unrecognized state, unclassified integrity failure, malformed proposal, missing required authority, or inability to prove exact artifact/actor/causal-parent binding produces INVALID or DEFER; never ADMIT by default.

forbidden_inferences: same visible text -> same artifact identity
caller assertion content -> objective generated fact
V2 appraisal/salience/response move -> V3 causal interpretation
V2 chat-turn/session cursor -> V3 causal-session cursor
receipt audit timestamp -> generated event time
payload hash equality alone -> duplicate occurrence for distinct lawful inbound events

hostile_fixtures.case: same proposal_id reused with changed content/hash
V2 package includes admit=true, relationship_delta or effect result

hostile_fixtures.expected: may admit occurrence of caller assertion if lawful; never promotes proposition to objective generated fact

hostile_fixtures.case: outbound pending candidate with exact artifact/hash and valid predecessor
hostile_fixtures.expected: eligible for ADMIT; publication only after ADMIT receipt

hostile_fixtures.case: candidate artifact bytes/hash differ from proposal or render receipt
rerender after prior ADMIT, even with same visible text
rejected candidate remains in V2 transcript
hostile_fixtures.expected: audit/session only; no V3 event, effect, or causal-session advance

hostile_fixtures.case: historical-style LLM fallback/first-candidate selection attempts direct deltas
hostile_fixtures.expected: blocked; proposal-only path; zero direct mutation

hostile_fixtures.case: well-formed proposal against stale V3 history hash or causal-session cursor
network retry of already ADMITted proposal_id+hash
hostile_fixtures.expected: same stored receipt/event; no duplicate append or cursor increment

hostile_fixtures.case: event_kind authority or required coherent-event semantics missing
transcript row exists but no ExternalInteractionProposal/admission receipt
environment/caller assertion lacks authority to promote claim as objective environment fact
hostile_fixtures.expected: preserve assertion epistemic class or DEFER/REJECT; never auto-promote

hostile_fixtures.case: outbound candidate actor/context does not match subject or admitted inbound predecessor
same terminally rejected artifact repackaged under new proposal_id
post-render substantive transform creates new artifact hash after admission
hostile_fixtures.expected: old admission does not cover transform; new candidate/proposal required

hostile_fixtures.case: positive source check coexists with explicit governed denial
hostile_fixtures.expected: REJECT; explicit denial cannot be overridden

compatibility_constraints: Preserve V3 DevelopmentalEventLedger as sole generated causal event history.
Preserve V3/V2 publication gate and CANDIDATE_NONCAUSAL_PENDING_V3_ADMISSION state.
CAN-025 may change V2 transport shape but must losslessly satisfy V3_EXTERNAL_ADMISSION_ENVELOPE requirements.
CAN-024 may choose/route interaction modes but cannot bypass or decide this admission court.
CAN-013 may adapt LLM proposals but must remove direct mutation/fallback authority and submit through this court.
MUST-020 may govern stochastic candidate selection/replay but randomness cannot override an admission failure.
No transcript/session database entry is accepted as event-ledger evidence absent this rule's ADMIT receipt.

This W0 cell does not release implementation by itself.
